programme.title: 驅魔少年 #88
programme.desc: 拉比受困於蘿特創造的異空間之中,他在那裡受到黑教團夥伴的攻擊。他告訴自己這是蘿特創造的世界,試圖擺脫眼前的幻影。然而幻影不斷施加攻擊與折磨,感到痛苦難耐的他大聲哀號,之後周圍轉變為拉比的兒時光景。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #89
programme.desc: 拉比朝自己施放火判,赤紅的地獄之火無情地吞噬他的身體。試圖拯救拉比的亞連見狀使盡最大的力量,揮劍斬斷逼近的火焰。利娜莉則反覆大喊他的名字,然而火焰卻完全包圍住拉比。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #14
programme.desc: 在小茜的帶領下,阿奎亞在將要上演《東京BLADE》的劇場裡觀看舞台劇。觀賞到由GOA撰寫腳本所改編出來的作品讓阿奎亞深受衝擊,進而深信他的實力。這樣的他所做出的舉動是…!

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #15
programme.desc: 亞枇子觀賞了由GOA操刀的舞台劇,開始相信GOA的才華。但卻提出如果要讓GOA撰寫劇本,就必須答應亞枇子一個條件。然而就在腳本完成之時,接踵而來的,卻是阿奎亞的試煉…!?

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #9
programme.desc: 萊利娜為了聖火儀式被賦予了嚴苛任務,疲憊不已的她來到泉水邊,也因此救起了一隻溺水的鳥。但剛好在場的大神官希卡認為去救註定要死的鳥只是白費功夫,兩人因此起了口角。希卡事後遍尋整個神殿,卻怎麼都找不到那個對自己失禮,但又令人在意不已的萊利娜。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #10
programme.desc: 希卡看中萊利娜的才能,為了收她為徒而拚盡全力。他不僅打開了那道鮮少開啟,通往神聖國的大門,召喚出聖騎士團,以展現大神官的威嚴,甚至還為了表現親和力,而說出可以叫他「爺爺」的這種話。就在此時,萊利娜配戴的珠寶髮飾發出了詭異的光芒。

programme.title: GRAND BLUE 碧藍之海 (第一季) #10
programme.desc: 成員們終於抵達沖繩。大家為住宿的別墅之豪華感到驚嘆,隨即便換裝衝向海邊!本來是這樣想的,但如果是在別墅前男生們馬上就會脫光衣服,所以最後只好移動到人比較多的海灘,一群人坐著香蕉船胡鬧了一番。在盡情玩樂後的隔天,等待著一行人的是他們此行的目的:潛水講習。然而,在香蕉船勝負中敗北、因而得睡在奈奈華和梓房間的伊織,因為滿滿的邪念導致腦袋當機了!?

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球大神祕(國語)
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 主日講壇-基督之家第五家
programme.desc: 基督之家第五家 講題:「信」者無懼 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 福音電影: 亞洲英雄-沒有硝煙的戰爭
programme.desc: 自古亂世出英雄,在2003年春天的一場沒有硝煙的戰爭中,一群捨己救人的真英雄誕生了。在一輪出生入死的拚搏過後,寫下了香港杏林史上引以為傲的一頁,亦叫早己冷卻的心再一次跳動。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-婚姻的藍圖
programme.desc: 何偉強牧師從婚姻中遇到的不同課題,包括理財、溝通、姻親關係、性愛……助你從《聖經》中瞭解處理方法,你經營一段美好的婚姻。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行IV 鐵証待判
programme.desc: 《地球深度行4之鐵證待判》繼續以遊歷的方式,走進荷蘭、土耳其、約旦、敍利亞,涉及接近50個地點,超過30個已經發生嘅神蹟預言、傳奇故事,以考古和實證,重新解構連科學都不能解釋的千古謎團。 歷年來有無數的考古學家和世界知名的紀錄片頻道,為瞭解開上帝藉著摩西施行神蹟分割紅海這個歷史迷團,他們都不惜花上大量的財力物力,研發新科技,要到紅海的海底尋找歷史証據。這集創世電視會直撀約旦,踏足每一處地方,搜羅各種鐵證,帶你經歷摩西如何施行神蹟分割紅海,從埃及法老王手中,帶領以色列人平安走過紅海,離開埃及。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-見字如面 從傳教士翻譯聖經 看福音的價值
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」

programme.title: 屬靈教室:何偉強牧師-婚姻的藍圖
programme.desc: 何偉強牧師從婚姻中遇到的不同課題,包括理財、溝通、姻親關係、性愛……助你從《聖經》中瞭解處理方法,你經營一段美好的婚姻。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。 一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天4 能回家真好
programme.desc: 每一個人,都需要一個溫暖、安全,可以得到庇護的家。可是,能回家的路不是必然,可以與摯愛天家相聚也並非絕對,突如起來的天災,毫無先兆的頑疾,極速致命的意外,誤入歧途的決定,足以令一個家毀於一旦。 第四輯《如果還有明天》搜羅多個見證故事,有50年代經典歌曲《情人的眼淚》原唱者潘秀瓊、《陰陽路》編劇、狗仔隊之父、被癌症纏擾的中國商人…… 他們的家都曾經陷入崩潰邊緣,明天的路更是舉步為艱,但在絕望邊緣他們遇見上帝,重新發現有一個「家」是永遠不被摧毀、不會改變,可以成為他們永恆的避難所。

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 劉三論今-十項全能的家系列
programme.desc: 羅馬書12:13 說:「聖徒缺乏,要幫補。」你覺得這也適用於你的家庭嗎?為什麼? 創世電視「信仰生活」系列 《劉三論今》,以聖經觀點來講述婚姻家庭的重要性,加進動畫、話劇、布偶及演奏的不同元素,以接地氣的輕鬆方式來教導我們婚姻家庭的經營。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 福音電影: 亞洲英雄-沒有硝煙的戰爭
programme.desc: 自古亂世出英雄,在2003年春天的一場沒有硝煙的戰爭中,一群捨己救人的真英雄誕生了。在一輪出生入死的拚搏過後,寫下了香港杏林史上引以為傲的一頁,亦叫早己冷卻的心再一次跳動。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 今日說法
programme.desc: 《今日說法》是一檔日播法治欄目,秉持“點滴記錄中國法治進程的理念,以“重在普法,監督執法,促進立法、服務百姓為宗旨,採用“以案說法、大眾參與、專家點評的節目樣式進行普法宣傳,被譽“中國人的法制午餐。節目前半部分呈現記者深入基層採訪的真實案例,後半部分由演播室中的主持人和嘉賓對節目進行點評,體現節目品質和社會價值。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 百年黃金路‧香港再啟航粵
茶煲世家#54粵PG
programme.desc: 劍棠接受電視台邀請，出席一電影頒獎典禮，更乘機打探復出之路。劍棠要求家玲陪他出席盛會，乘機向她表白愛意，令她受寵若驚。劍棠在宴會上重遇當年銀幕情侶拍檔艷芬芳，眼見她與丈夫恩愛非常，大表嫉妒，竟介紹家玲為他的未婚妻以示威，家玲不甘受利用，拂袖而去。子東為拉攏家玲與劍棠，與明輝施計將二人困在屋內，使二人和好如初，怎料鄰居發生大火，劍棠遂帶家玲爬窗求生，期間不慎墮樓，二人同告受傷。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#6粵普
programme.desc: 十一娘因未熟悉徐府事務，故暫由蓮房掌管中饋；徐府領來御賜蜀錦，十一娘提出為各房設計扇面繡樣。令宜重提廢除海禁之事，區家怕會危及其與海盜的走私生意，令人監視令宜舉動；另方面，令宜欲拉攏衛國公以獲得助力。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 牛腱有多種之分，鼎爺偕同阿譚請教牛肉檔負責人，認識各個牛腱部位。二人購入金錢腱與花腱炮製「滷水牛腱」，親自驗證兩種牛腱的不同口感，並公開「鼎級」滷水配方。鼎爺繼續「全牛宴」，烹調「黑椒蘆筍牛冧肉」之前，他要阿譚先把黑胡椒下白鍋烘烤，有何作用？炒牛肉最怕肉質變老，且看鼎爺示範當中秘訣。世界各地出產的馬鈴薯，分別適合烹調甚麼菜式？鼎爺巧手奉上兩種做法的「薯蓉牛肉餅」，還分享把馬鈴薯輕鬆去皮的妙法。

programme.title: 百年黃金路‧香港再啟航粵
流行都市粵
programme.desc: 整形手術普遍到連私密部位都涵蓋？整形外科醫生概述顧客有相關整形需要的原因。女士的陰部內層結構有保護、滋潤等功能，如何判斷是肥大或過長，有何手術可改善？醫生提醒，手術是為自己而做，並非為他人或跟從潮流。鄧達智帶大王、菲比走進西貢一間北印度菜館，發掘店內街頭小吃、開胃菜、咖喱主菜與薄餅的獨特「味力」。這次「睇餸食飯」的佳餚名為「欖角鯪魚黑珍珠」，三姐選用甚麼食材跟鯪魚肉混和，然後蒸出一顆顆「黑珍珠」？

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 長期受壓令內臟容易衰老，減壓是抗衰老的必修科。戴祖儀用被單包裹身體，竟發揮神奇減壓作用？精神科醫生解釋是模仿嬰兒在胎內動作，配合音樂、香氣更有助舒緩情緒，細說暴力洩憤的利弊和深呼吸減壓法。逆齡偵探到台灣尋找不老配方，專家講解「奇芭汁」含有維他命C可改善情緒；另類花椒、八角咖啡令心情變佳？甜食為何會令人心情開朗？營養師教製開心小食。鄧佩儀、黃庭鋒推介發酵洗米水潔面，皮膚科醫生解說當中原理及注意事項。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#16粵PG
programme.desc: 正花聲稱有孕，其西、兆良即與街坊分享好消息。柔紫緊張冠一傷勢，卻被勸阻到澳門探望。娛樂集團股價因開槍事件大跌，駿昇要美詩設法挽回娛樂城的形象，堵截負面新聞。曦昕取笑駿昇連月華都不相信他，決定離家，美詩勸曦昕冷靜，否則會影響駿昇的形象。美詩提議駿昇往醫院探病，讓公眾知道他關心冠一，化解不利傳聞。柔紫返戲曲中心，被安排與月華合唱，柔紫開始盤算計策。正花向兆良坦白有孕純屬謊話，並提出離婚……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子在雜誌上看見百貨公司懸紅尋找槌之子，正好小玉在學校說自己看到槌之子被質疑，兩人加上丸尾一起尋找槌之子，並計劃用獎金成立末玉桃槌之子股份有限公司，將來享受榮華富貴、窮奢極侈。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 四位「勇廠」小兵之中，三人都機靈地避開芭菲精靈的誤導，未有做出沒附帶「廠長話」的動作，令給予指令的芭菲精靈也累了，結果要怎樣才可分出勝負？輪到推地壺收集食材遊戲，本以為曲奇小兵團用四次機會就能完成任務，但經芭菲精靈覆檢後，原來有地壺差少許才命中圖案，導致小兵空歡喜一場！踏上「溶化之橋」運送雪糕，薯片男兵「投訴」被雪糕球遮擋視線，無法看清道路；第二次運送時決定減少一球，其步伐明顯加快，笑容也增多了！

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 阿渡和阿驅打算對打練習，卻發現麒麟丸受損嚴重有待修理，阿驅把麒麟丸拆散，之後卻不懂重組回去，因而大受打擊，意志消沉。阿渡與睡不著的阿驅聊天，一句無心之言啟發後者重新創造魔神。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 慢性乙型肝炎，有機會會發展成肝癌或肝硬化，最新的基因療法的治療作用如何？有統計顯示，子宮頸癌的發病年齡有年輕化趨勢，作為婦女，有甚麼初期徵狀需要留意？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 百年黃金路‧香港再啟航粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 有雜貨店被偷竊飲品，店方提供閉路電視片段，指相關貨品價值雖然不高，但不應貪小便宜而觸犯法規。香港仔某巴士總站一帶，有男子常於夜間裸露下體，更做出不雅行為，令街坊感到噁心及不安。攝製隊連日追蹤，記者現身要求男子回應；心理學家推測其心理狀態。陳豪與陳茵媺夫妻檔出席活動，預告一家人慶祝聖誕節的活動。《新聞女王2》演員齊集商場收看大結局，順道為頒獎禮獎項拉票。另一探酒店從業員如何展現香港旅遊業好客之道。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2703粵
programme.desc: 樹仁因事未能操刀拍攝接龍月曆，遂找來名攝影師代勞。Ceci仰慕這位大師，提出要參與拍攝。敢威因某些理由允許Ceci加入，並讓她全權作主。若水等人收到月曆，察覺其中暗藏不少「玄機」，馬漢更稱曾聽到敢威與Ceci的對話，令眾人更加確信接龍將有大事發生。不少人設法討好Ceci，敢威知悉秘密網上瘋傳關於接龍的不實傳聞，遂嘗試穩定軍心。另一方面，眾人藉着Ceci獲取不少好處，Ceci卻反遭牽連，苦不堪言……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#1粵PG
programme.desc: 熱鬧繁華的香港街頭，大螢幕播放著“O記之星”何浩輝在一次行動中向匪徒下跪的視頻，引爆全港熱議，因此事何浩輝被調職到衝鋒隊。他已暗下決心，為了師父、邵sir、警隊，一定要把周雄繩之以法。

programme.title: 去有風的地方#20粵普
programme.desc: 鳳姨兒子謝強出獄，村裡長輩在酒席上說的話令氣氛尷尬，之遙挺身解圍，還因喝了不少酒而醉倒。小葫蘆的爺爺奶奶來看她表演，之後在飯桌上曉春因為小葫蘆去不去昆明讀書的問題，與小葫蘆爺爺大吵一架，憤而離席。

programme.title: 大航假期呈獻:玩轉桂林懶人包粵
programme.desc: 堯山可俯瞰桂林市景，正峰隨家燕姐乘纜車登峰，會合廣沛盡覽壯麗山林、三色堇花海，沉醉夢幻景色！藉美食細味廣西民族風情，油茶配壯鄉簸箕菜佐吃，或作湯底焯斑魚片，奉上不同滋味。往非遺體驗館DIY圓竹剖絲團扇，家燕姐勾起學生回憶？正峰學做石畫，滋養文化氣息。桂菜以灕江食材入饌，花膠魚羹養顏養胃；小河蝦採生醃、薑蔥兩做法，連殼食衝擊味蕾。深入千年地下溶洞冠岩，坐小火車一睹千變萬化的鐘乳石奇觀，更可「觀星」？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
名媛望族#2粵
programme.desc: 爾嫣看穿卓萬邀子君演出之目的；子君弄傷警察容達志，啟燊告子君襲警以留住她，子君道出亡命天涯經過。木水把小由帶到達志家，提出讓她住達志祖母笑歡家，笑歡答應。小由探望鳳凰後，按她的吩咐帶棋子「卒」丟卓萬。

programme.desc: 有雜貨店被偷竊飲品，店方提供閉路電視片段，指相關貨品價值雖然不高，但不應貪小便宜而觸犯法規。香港仔某巴士總站一帶，有男子常於夜間裸露下體，更做出不雅行為，令街坊感到噁心及不安。攝製隊連日追蹤，記者現身要求男子回應；心理學家推測其心理狀態。陳豪與陳茵媺夫妻檔出席活動，預告一家人慶祝聖誕節的活動。《新聞女王2》演員齊集商場收看大結局，順道為頒獎禮獎項拉票。另一探酒店從業員如何展現香港旅遊業好客之道。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 整形手術普遍到連私密部位都涵蓋？整形外科醫生概述顧客有相關整形需要的原因。女士的陰部內層結構有保護、滋潤等功能，如何判斷是肥大或過長，有何手術可改善？醫生提醒，手術是為自己而做，並非為他人或跟從潮流。鄧達智帶大王、菲比走進西貢一間北印度菜館，發掘店內街頭小吃、開胃菜、咖喱主菜與薄餅的獨特「味力」。這次「睇餸食飯」的佳餚名為「欖角鯪魚黑珍珠」，三姐選用甚麼食材跟鯪魚肉混和，然後蒸出一顆顆「黑珍珠」？

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 長期受壓令內臟容易衰老，減壓是抗衰老的必修科。戴祖儀用被單包裹身體，竟發揮神奇減壓作用？精神科醫生解釋是模仿嬰兒在胎內動作，配合音樂、香氣更有助舒緩情緒，細說暴力洩憤的利弊和深呼吸減壓法。逆齡偵探到台灣尋找不老配方，專家講解「奇芭汁」含有維他命C可改善情緒；另類花椒、八角咖啡令心情變佳？甜食為何會令人心情開朗？營養師教製開心小食。鄧佩儀、黃庭鋒推介發酵洗米水潔面，皮膚科醫生解說當中原理及注意事項。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#16粵PG
programme.desc: 正花聲稱有孕，其西、兆良即與街坊分享好消息。柔紫緊張冠一傷勢，卻被勸阻到澳門探望。娛樂集團股價因開槍事件大跌，駿昇要美詩設法挽回娛樂城的形象，堵截負面新聞。曦昕取笑駿昇連月華都不相信他，決定離家，美詩勸曦昕冷靜，否則會影響駿昇的形象。美詩提議駿昇往醫院探病，讓公眾知道他關心冠一，化解不利傳聞。柔紫返戲曲中心，被安排與月華合唱，柔紫開始盤算計策。正花向兆良坦白有孕純屬謊話，並提出離婚……

programme.title: 茶煲世家#54粵PG
programme.desc: 劍棠接受電視台邀請，出席一電影頒獎典禮，更乘機打探復出之路。劍棠要求家玲陪他出席盛會，乘機向她表白愛意，令她受寵若驚。劍棠在宴會上重遇當年銀幕情侶拍檔艷芬芳，眼見她與丈夫恩愛非常，大表嫉妒，竟介紹家玲為他的未婚妻以示威，家玲不甘受利用，拂袖而去。子東為拉攏家玲與劍棠，與明輝施計將二人困在屋內，使二人和好如初，怎料鄰居發生大火，劍棠遂帶家玲爬窗求生，期間不慎墮樓，二人同告受傷。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#6粵普
programme.desc: 十一娘因未熟悉徐府事務，故暫由蓮房掌管中饋；徐府領來御賜蜀錦，十一娘提出為各房設計扇面繡樣。令宜重提廢除海禁之事，區家怕會危及其與海盜的走私生意，令人監視令宜舉動；另方面，令宜欲拉攏衛國公以獲得助力。

programme.title: 街坊廚神舌戰新台韓粵
programme.desc: 金剛、小儀請來曾志偉、陳展鵬、田蕊妮三位重量級嘉賓，加入壓軸的韓國之旅！一行人穿梭魚市場攤檔、「醬蟹街」店舖、「水族館」食肆，大吃即買即煮海上鮮！「街坊尋味」，主持在當地「型男美女」助手引路下，吃到做法繁複及「鐡板上」的韓國炸雞滋味。香港的元祖韓國炸雞店提供的各款炸雞口味，可會與首爾的一樣「冇得輸」？「學廚PK賽」，兩位「廚神」即學即煮「蜑家胡椒魚肚湯」，戰況如何？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵

茶煲世家#55粵
programme.desc: 家玲與劍棠留院療傷，患難見真情，感情大躍進。家宜不滿子東連累家玲可能破相，與子東反目，竟鬧離婚。子南結識新女友糖糖，已到談婚論婚階段，子東知道糖糖全家已移民外地，惟婚後仍要與其姐同住，要子南以他為戒。家玲以為破相，幸得劍棠開解，解除顧忌，毅然答應婚事。正當家宜對離婚之事三心兩意之時，發現已有懷孕，把報告放在桌上後回房，此時子東與耀國等人傾談客戶事宜，子東更一氣之下撕毀合同，令家宜誤會，決定離婚。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#7粵普
programme.desc: 回門之日，羅大太太嚴責十一娘讓主母之權旁落，在席上語帶諷刺，徐令宜為十一娘解圍，但也認為是她私下告狀，十一娘無心辯解，二人不歡而散。喬蓮房用計得到本應是十一娘的蜀錦，陶媽媽為十一娘出頭，與人大打出手。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 由於祖父曾經營醬園，鼎爺對各種醬料的製作所知甚豐。除了講解新、舊南乳的分別，他還提到發霉的南乳仍然可用？鼎爺分享醃製「南乳雞翼」的小竅門，關鍵竟是腐乳！他再以南乳烹調一道惹味的「溫公粗齋」，大家只要記住燜煮食材的次序，亦可容易做到。鼎爺向拍檔推介心水靚湯「蜜瓜螺頭花膠燉湯」，阿譚本對用水果燉湯有所保留，但細嚐過後立即改觀！鼎爺分別買來急凍螺頭與乾螺頭燉湯，並分享正確的處理方法。

programme.title: 百年黃金路‧香港再啟航粵
流行都市粵
programme.desc: 小細胞肺癌因擴散速度快、存活率低，被稱為「肺癌中的惡霸」。臨床腫瘤科醫生指出，吸煙是主要病因，而且早期症狀並不明顯，往往確診時癌症已經擴散。醫生指治療以化療、放射治療、免疫療法為主，並詳析相關資訊。髖關節退化性關節炎常見於四十歲以上人士，病徵包括行路跛行、腰部疼痛。脊醫細說如何分辨此症與一般腰骨痛，並提供防治資訊，還會向主持傳授有助預防的鍛練運動。「睇餸食飯」環節，保哥炮製「馬蹄炒南非鮮鮑」。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 脂肪困擾問題相當普遍，逆齡偵探在台北夜市嚴選「食極唔肥」美食，關東煮、鹽水雞、滷味，哪款可勝出不肥比拼？負卡路里食物又是甚麼一回事？嘉賓蕭徽勇自述暴肥黑歷史，他採用的重啟身體蔬果斷食法，專家卻指並非人人適合。想踢走脂肪，不如試試消脂組合動作！坊間的真空收腹法，據稱亦可令肚腩拜拜。要了解脂肪狀況，先量腰圍測試中央肥胖指標；脂肪肝又怎樣形成？文軒、祖儀可有患上脂肪肝的風險？醫生並講解脂肪肝的防治良方。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#17粵PG
programme.desc: 正花前往澳門探望冠一，向眾同門透露已提出離婚，眾錯愕。其西到澳門質問正花離婚決定，正花坦言最愛冠一，其西怒摑她。美詩將自己與柏義的聊天紀錄傳給曦昕，讓曦昕得知二人姦情。駿昇為月華補祝生日，月華指自己已有新生活，勸駿昇放棄等待。柔紫造訪月華家，閒談間說出丈夫有外遇的往事，並密謀下藥，可惜事敗。兆良到澳門求與正花重新開始，正花拒絕，兆良用槍指嚇她，冠一以身擋槍……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子從山田口中得知名為《惡鬼之子笑了》的故事，然後有天在公園遇到一名女孩，其後發生的事與故事情節雷同。小丸子被迫與山根一起成立「不虛度二月協會」，首個任務便是要訓練自己早起。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 身心健康是互為影響，因此同樣重要。這集「Kids’ Notes」請來心理學家，一同關注孩子心理狀況。嘉賓提到隨着社會環境轉變，父母越加重視孩子的情緒發展，並建議小朋友多跟家長傾訴心事。社交、學業都可成為壓力來源，他即場示範呼吸減壓妙法。小朋友的解難能力仍於成長階段，面對困難時或未能即刻找到解決方法，從而形成壓力。對於可視壓力為推動力，嘉賓有何看法？他又建議孩子於遇到挑戰時，多以鼓勵說話為自己打氣。

programme.title: 魔神創造傳粵日
programme.desc: 阿渡和阿驅拍片癮發作，並趁機向瑪蘿學習拍片秘訣，此時另一名RyuTuber紅企鵝講師出現，其魔性配樂和口號令人不禁咐和，紅企鵝加入一起授課，但內容卻越趨嚴格，後來更出現強人所難的無理要求。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 日出康城新盤交樓，房間玻璃有明顯刮花，木地板鬆脫拱起，洗衣機安裝太近露台圍欄，有甚麼潛在影響？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 百年黃金路‧香港再啟航粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2704粵
programme.desc: 尚善要兼顧電影公司，工作量大增，卻仍苦苦支撐。力蓮虎視眈眈，欲取而代之，接掌電影公司。杜演等人工作散漫，尚善設法整治，本來成效顯著，卻遭力蓮破壞，只好另想辦法，成功令片場迎來一番新氣象。其後，尚善意外受傷入院，杜演等人爭執不斷，最終導致停廠停工；力蓮打算向敢威告狀，圖謀接掌電影公司。尚善前往片場處理問題，片場卻於此時發生意外，幸得某人之故才免卻重大損失，尚善亦因此找到出任片場話事人的最佳人選……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#2粵PG
programme.desc: 鐘志華被周雄報復殺害，孫女鐘嵐君被蔣坤收為義女，何浩輝得知龍興社正在尋找一個外國人，看到了從天臺下樓的戈登，察覺此事頗為蹊蹺，告訴陳耀揚卻被警告不要多管閒事，邵峰讓陳耀揚將心比心，對何浩輝放下芥蒂。

programme.title: 去有風的地方#21粵普
programme.desc: 曉春前夫羅泉稱父親同意小葫蘆留村，曉春後來才知道羅泉為此被羅父打了一頓。阿桂嬸告訴紅豆村裡不少人也想做生意致富，但因村委會找之遙給意見，令大家誤會他從中作梗，想一家獨大，後來一群人更跑來阻止民宿施工。

programme.title: 大航假期呈獻:玩轉桂林懶人包粵
programme.desc: 龍勝以歷史悠久的龍脊梯田聞名，三人暢遊層層疊疊的綠色波浪。到黃洛瑤寨賞民族歌舞，一探紅瑤姑娘「天下第一長髮」秘密；廣沛、正峰更被選中上台「成親」，早前求婚成功的廣沛急向鏡頭解畫……竹筒飯清香可口，兩男獲家燕姐餵食，份外滋味！轉玩陽朔如意峰，乘纜車登上「天空之城」，穿梭索橋、雲頂平台，峰林景色全方位盡入眼簾！品嚐農家菜的酸麻風味後，坐竹筏夜遊遇龍河，家燕姐興致大發唱山歌，鸕鷀遵漁夫指令捕魚亦甚神奇。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵

名媛望族#3粵PG
programme.desc: 子君得大律師霍百鏘替她辯護，只被罰款但須跟廷亨回家，卓萬指子君非廷亨婢女。子君感謝卓萬，卓萬要求她再表演。木水把兩粒珍珠串成頸鏈送小由。蟹嫂追房租，小由提議用珍珠解急，木水不肯。子君得知送錢給小由。

programme.desc: 小細胞肺癌因擴散速度快、存活率低，被稱為「肺癌中的惡霸」。臨床腫瘤科醫生指出，吸煙是主要病因，而且早期症狀並不明顯，往往確診時癌症已經擴散。醫生指治療以化療、放射治療、免疫療法為主，並詳析相關資訊。髖關節退化性關節炎常見於四十歲以上人士，病徵包括行路跛行、腰部疼痛。脊醫細說如何分辨此症與一般腰骨痛，並提供防治資訊，還會向主持傳授有助預防的鍛練運動。「睇餸食飯」環節，保哥炮製「馬蹄炒南非鮮鮑」。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 脂肪困擾問題相當普遍，逆齡偵探在台北夜市嚴選「食極唔肥」美食，關東煮、鹽水雞、滷味，哪款可勝出不肥比拼？負卡路里食物又是甚麼一回事？嘉賓蕭徽勇自述暴肥黑歷史，他採用的重啟身體蔬果斷食法，專家卻指並非人人適合。想踢走脂肪，不如試試消脂組合動作！坊間的真空收腹法，據稱亦可令肚腩拜拜。要了解脂肪狀況，先量腰圍測試中央肥胖指標；脂肪肝又怎樣形成？文軒、祖儀可有患上脂肪肝的風險？醫生並講解脂肪肝的防治良方。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#17粵PG
programme.desc: 正花前往澳門探望冠一，向眾同門透露已提出離婚，眾錯愕。其西到澳門質問正花離婚決定，正花坦言最愛冠一，其西怒摑她。美詩將自己與柏義的聊天紀錄傳給曦昕，讓曦昕得知二人姦情。駿昇為月華補祝生日，月華指自己已有新生活，勸駿昇放棄等待。柔紫造訪月華家，閒談間說出丈夫有外遇的往事，並密謀下藥，可惜事敗。兆良到澳門求與正花重新開始，正花拒絕，兆良用槍指嚇她，冠一以身擋槍……

programme.title: 茶煲世家#55粵
programme.desc: 家玲與劍棠留院療傷，患難見真情，感情大躍進。家宜不滿子東連累家玲可能破相，與子東反目，竟鬧離婚。子南結識新女友糖糖，已到談婚論婚階段，子東知道糖糖全家已移民外地，惟婚後仍要與其姐同住，要子南以他為戒。家玲以為破相，幸得劍棠開解，解除顧忌，毅然答應婚事。正當家宜對離婚之事三心兩意之時，發現已有懷孕，把報告放在桌上後回房，此時子東與耀國等人傾談客戶事宜，子東更一氣之下撕毀合同，令家宜誤會，決定離婚。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#7粵普
programme.desc: 回門之日，羅大太太嚴責十一娘讓主母之權旁落，在席上語帶諷刺，徐令宜為十一娘解圍，但也認為是她私下告狀，十一娘無心辯解，二人不歡而散。喬蓮房用計得到本應是十一娘的蜀錦，陶媽媽為十一娘出頭，與人大打出手。

programme.title: 娛樂大家粵
programme.desc: 曾被病魔煎熬的洪卓立自稱見過白色隧道，期間還聽到聲音直呼其名；HANA菊梓喬曾被人誤以為是色魔，歌手們認真「大件事」！不過，「事件」孰真孰假？刺客王余德丞嘗試新玩法，成功於第一晚帶走皇帝林穎彤，重創好人陣營。玩得多「狼人」遊戲，竟令戴祖儀不再相信男人，尤其是外貌甚「鈍」的謝東閔？新一屆視帝、視后的候選名單尚待公佈，阿姐竟有魔法分辨誰人封帝稱后！洪卓立、HANA、吳浩康、谷婭溦、譚嘉儀能否拆解玄機？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 百年黃金路‧香港再啟航粵
茶煲世家#56粵
programme.desc: (大結局)家宜誤會子東罔顧腹中骨肉，堅決與他離婚，子東遂帶同驗孕報告向家宜澄清，二人終和好。Roger告知子東公司將分配一宿舍單位給他，二人將是鄰居，並且考慮由達松和明輝爭取接任子東原來職位。達松遂施計偷走明輝之計劃書，幸明輝發覺及時取回文件，成功升職。劍棠與家玲正為找尋新居頭痛，子東提議把現居賣給家玲，家玲即以當年原價買入，子東啞口無言。幾日後，家玲到地產公司咨詢，並主動提高售樓價，子東即答應。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#8粵普PG
programme.desc: 十一娘和徐令宜為蜀錦一事再次鬧得不歡而散。蓮房故意在徐令宜面前穿蜀錦欲討他歡心，卻被徐令宜以冷言冷語對待，深深不憤，因而設計擄走十一娘，以圖破壞其名聲，琥珀回羅府告知太夫人此事，太夫人深感事有蹺蹊。

programme.title: 阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 中國茶不但是飯後消滯去膩的佳品，原來亦可入饌，為菜式添上絲絲茶香美味。鼎爺今回先用龍井茶葉搭配鳳尾蝦，帶來清香的「龍井蝦仁」；及後再以普洱茶葉煮雞，奉上煙燻味香濃的「茶燻雞」。除了分享昔日和「老頭子」自製魚桿釣河蝦的美好回憶，鼎爺還會介紹保存茶葉的傳統方法。人參大有補身、補氣的功效，焗水、煲湯皆宜。鼎爺外出細說揀選優質高麗參及吉林紅參的「小貼士」之後，返回「煮場」獻技，呈獻滋補佳餚「高麗參浸雞」。

programme.title: 百年黃金路‧香港再啟航粵
programme.desc: 上世紀七、八十年代，香港已是全球黃金交易樞紐。擁有完整的黃金生態鏈，包括國際標準的驗證中心、專業煉鑄商及嚴格的註冊制度等。2024年施政報告提出，把香港打造為「國際黃金交易中心」。香港黃金交易所繼承前身「金銀業貿易場」的百年經驗，除了配合政府提升產業配套，建議政府在未來「國際黃金中央結算系統」，擔當推動政策及維護市場秩序的角色，具體運作則交由本地業界，透過市場主導，提高交易效率和信心。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 肥胖症是指體內脂肪過度堆積，有人或會患有肌少症而BMI只顯示略為偏高，這類「肌少型肥胖症」患者容易被忽略。病人有何常見症狀，較易引發甚麼嚴重併發症？內分泌及糖尿科醫生亦細說以「慢減重加保肌」為目標的治療方案。人面對突如其來的事故，或會令情緒受影響，精神科醫生到來提出幾個疏導負面情緒的建議，並向大家傳授一些控制情緒的小練習。飲碗熱湯有助禦寒，傅季馨在「睇餸食飯」教大家製作「煎帶子伴栗子蓉湯」暖暖身。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 鄧佩儀、許文軒往肇慶鼎湖尋找補腦秘技，答案竟是大媽廣場舞？馮盈盈、江嘉敏即席自創舞步，腦科醫生解說跳舞有助增強記憶力，並進行腦力測試及訓練左右腦協調方法。探訪鼎湖91歲老伯，拆解長壽村鮮為人知的不老秘密！何謂「加齡臭」？中醫建議進食清熱潤燥食品，還教沖飲緩和體味的竹葉菊花茶。營養師推介泰式健腦三文魚藜麥��律，有益腦部健康及延緩記憶衰退，並講解麥得飲食(MIND Diet)，一隻雞蛋能有助集中精神？

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#18粵PG
programme.desc: 兆良持警槍偷渡往澳門，被勒令停職接受調查。家聰主動找曦昕關心狀況，加以開解。阿昌終認得天龍之情婦柔紫，駿昇認定柔紫接近月華有企圖，到醫院要求冠一及正花帶他到港搜尋。駿昇在冠一家不見月華蹤影，緊張地要冠一找出柔紫所在，卻不成功。月華與駿昇分別向柔紫、冠一解釋當日事情及過往兄弟相處之事宜。冠一終找到被擊暈的柔紫，月華卻下落不明。月華醒來，驚見天龍在眼前……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 情人節將至，姐姐打算自製巧克力送給秀樹，但看見小渚為花輪特別炮製的巧克力後，決定投放更多心思重新製作。小杉因身型肥大，玩擠饅頭遊戲特別受歡迎，豬太郎感到羨慕，於是想盡辦法增肥自己。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 又到做運動時間，依兒童體適能教練指示做幾下熱身跳，就正式開展「WORKOUT 2GETHER」。先是「全身力量訓練」，深蹲、平板支撐、超人式等熱門動作，如何做得好？收緊肚皮就是核心訓練的要點。弓步跳起時前後腳交替的動作，則可促進血液循環。輪到「下肢協調訓練」，同樣需要收緊肚皮，箭步蹲、側弓步、單腳原地跳、雙腳爆發跳，都有助改善平衡力，減少跌倒機會。動作做到熟練時，還可嘗試增加頻率，加強訓練效率。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: Ruby=Lazuli與AISMIRIN’兩大人氣組合攜手宣佈，偶像公主大賽即將舉行。學生會會長一條寺櫻與副會長二階堂珠希的Ruby=Lazuli也決定出戰第一場大賽。然而，珠希卻發現，櫻的真正目的並非大賽本身……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵
programme.desc: 香港經歷過多次的移民潮，八十年代有不少香港人選擇移居加拿大，引發「太空人」這社會現象的出現，即是那些已經移民他鄉，但是還未完全放棄香港的事業，需要兩地往返的人，新聞掏寶和大家重溫1989年的專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
有理說得清粵 及 百年黃金路‧香港再啟航粵
programme.desc: 兩位時事評論員屈穎妍、楊立門，同觀眾論盡天下事、國家事、香港事；大事小事，開門見山、言無不盡，《有理說得清》！

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2705粵
programme.desc: 天娥發現璟風為瑞素大灑金錢，認為瑞素存心「討着數」，遂警告她不可再亂花錢。瑞素決定與璟風採用「AA制」，各自支付自己應付的費用，結果讓璟風吃了不少苦頭。另一方面，瑞素即將出埠公幹，為「慳錢」而拒絕入住璟風為她安排的高級酒店。璟風想到一個可讓瑞素自願入住該酒店的方法，詎料……其後，瑞素如期前赴外地，酒店附近竟發生危險事故，璟風大感憂心，務要設法確保瑞素的安全……

programme.title: Return 關節筋肌配方呈獻 :守誠者#3粵PG
programme.desc: 林蔚言發現戈登涉嫌殺人的新聞，同時，戈登聯繫林蔚言，並以“一個足以摧毀香港的陰謀”取得了林蔚言信任，答應與他見面。何浩輝收到陳耀揚的資訊，獨自趕往李大年處，卻發現跟蹤自己的邵子俊。

programme.title: 去有風的地方#22粵普
programme.desc: 之遙得知紅豆被欺負，向其道歉，紅豆則因之遙遇事不說而生氣，之遙再寫信道歉。紅豆準備回北京處理房子水管爆裂一事時，之遙接到謝老師心臟病發的電話，紅豆陪其去醫院。謝老師病情逐漸好轉，之遙放心陪紅豆去北京。

programme.title: 大航假期呈獻:玩轉桂林懶人包粵
programme.desc: 「玩轉懶人包」系列再次北上，發掘更多「食買玩」情報。薛家燕這次與何廣沛、林正峰結伴出團，遊歷有「山水甲天下」美譽的廣西桂林，網羅結合獨特地貌、絕美風光與鮮味佳餚的旅遊攻略。暢遊象鼻山、灕江、龍脊梯田等名勝，乘登山纜車上堯山，深入千年地下溶洞，一探「山青、水秀、洞奇」的三絕景色。多樣美食、體驗在桂林，團隊品嚐廣西油茶、米粉、荔浦芋頭、「桂花宴」、「金桔宴」等地道滋味，還試穿民族服飾感受文化風情。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
名媛望族#4粵
programme.desc: 卓萬向廷亨暗示已知他勾當，要爭做商會主席，結果廷亨當選，啟燊終明卓萬用心。卓萬贈子君象棋，內藏頸鏈；懿芳代卓萬答應出席上海飯店剪綵，爾嫣竟考慮同行。心蘭與懿芳受傷，啟燁替卓萬找理由，讓他與爾嫣到上海。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.desc: 肥胖症是指體內脂肪過度堆積，有人或會患有肌少症而BMI只顯示略為偏高，這類「肌少型肥胖症」患者容易被忽略。病人有何常見症狀，較易引發甚麼嚴重併發症？內分泌及糖尿科醫生亦細說以「慢減重加保肌」為目標的治療方案。人面對突如其來的事故，或會令情緒受影響，精神科醫生到來提出幾個疏導負面情緒的建議，並向大家傳授一些控制情緒的小練習。飲碗熱湯有助禦寒，傅季馨在「睇餸食飯」教大家製作「煎帶子伴栗子蓉湯」暖暖身。

programme.title: 長命不老粵
programme.desc: 鄧佩儀、許文軒往肇慶鼎湖尋找補腦秘技，答案竟是大媽廣場舞？馮盈盈、江嘉敏即席自創舞步，腦科醫生解說跳舞有助增強記憶力，並進行腦力測試及訓練左右腦協調方法。探訪鼎湖91歲老伯，拆解長壽村鮮為人知的不老秘密！何謂「加齡臭」？中醫建議進食清熱潤燥食品，還教沖飲緩和體味的竹葉菊花茶。營養師推介泰式健腦三文魚藜麥沙律，有益腦部健康及延緩記憶衰退，並講解麥得飲食(MIND Diet)，一隻雞蛋能有助集中精神？

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#18粵PG
programme.desc: 兆良持警槍偷渡往澳門，被勒令停職接受調查。家聰主動找曦昕關心狀況，加以開解。阿昌終認得天龍之情婦柔紫，駿昇認定柔紫接近月華有企圖，到醫院要求冠一及正花帶他到港搜尋。駿昇在冠一家不見月華蹤影，緊張地要冠一找出柔紫所在，卻不成功。月華與駿昇分別向柔紫、冠一解釋當日事情及過往兄弟相處之事宜。冠一終找到被擊暈的柔紫，月華卻下落不明。月華醒來，驚見天龍在眼前……

programme.title: 茶煲世家#56粵
programme.desc: (大結局)家宜誤會子東罔顧腹中骨肉，堅決與他離婚，子東遂帶同驗孕報告向家宜澄清，二人終和好。Roger告知子東公司將分配一宿舍單位給他，二人將是鄰居，並且考慮由達松和明輝爭取接任子東原來職位。達松遂施計偷走明輝之計劃書，幸明輝發覺及時取回文件，成功升職。劍棠與家玲正為找尋新居頭痛，子東提議把現居賣給家玲，家玲即以當年原價買入，子東啞口無言。幾日後，家玲到地產公司咨詢，並主動提高售樓價，子東即答應。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#8粵普PG
programme.desc: 十一娘和徐令宜為蜀錦一事再次鬧得不歡而散。蓮房故意在徐令宜面前穿蜀錦欲討他歡心，卻被徐令宜以冷言冷語對待，深深不憤，因而設計擄走十一娘，以圖破壞其名聲，琥珀回羅府告知太夫人此事，太夫人深感事有蹺蹊。

programme.title: 乜都搞掂晒粵
programme.desc: 曾志偉請各人吃辣壽司，笑指有「吃wasabi不攻鼻」的秘方，並從化學角度解釋。張致恒親自示範2分鐘出門之法，並詳述如何極速綁鞋帶及打領呔。倒數飲管循環再用法的五強，飲管竟可通渠、變成迷你收納小管？

programme.title: 乜都搞掂晒粵
programme.desc: 陳展鵬指用粉筆為食物圍圈可防蟻蛀，這說法有否科學根據？有甚麼方法可以極速切橙，或極速倒出布丁？妙用蘋果皮及沸水，製造天然的鍋漬清潔劑。膠樽放入洗衣機竟有助除污？一同學習設立膠樽裝置活捉討厭蚊子！

programme.title: 我的魯蛇舅舅
programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人氣英劇／魯蛇舅舅Ｘ強迫症外甥溫馨爆笑的家庭喜劇】由《雖然是精神病但沒關係》的自閉症哥哥吳正世，首次擔任男主角，在選秀節目中獲勝的他，本該朝歌手夢前進，不料積蓄突然遭朋友騙光，從此一蹶不振，成為無業遊名。某天因為姊姊與家暴丈夫離婚，而開始照顧起強迫症的外甥，過程中兩人總是不斷鬥嘴，關係相愛又相殺，而他也從中找回責任感，成為外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 陌生人(完)
programme.desc: 【怪力媽搭配毒舌女母女笑鬧同居火花不斷】一個是凡事衝動、毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性、走自己路的女兒。原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常。從降職的糗事、誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此。越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方——這場「陌生人同居記」，意外寫下母女間最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 我的魯蛇舅舅
programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人氣英劇／魯蛇舅舅Ｘ強迫症外甥溫馨爆笑的家庭喜劇】由《雖然是精神病但沒關係》的自閉症哥哥吳正世，首次擔任男主角，在選秀節目中獲勝的他，本該朝歌手夢前進，不料積蓄突然遭朋友騙光，從此一蹶不振，成為無業遊名。某天因為姊姊與家暴丈夫離婚，而開始照顧起強迫症的外甥，過程中兩人總是不斷鬥嘴，關係相愛又相殺，而他也從中找回責任感，成為外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【王牌律師X怪物新人法律界最強拍檔真相一觸即發！】在韓國頂尖律師事務所KANG&HAM，崔江錫是無人能敵的王牌律師，精準果敢、戰無不勝。一次偶然，他遇見高延宇──沒有法學背景、未取得律師執照，卻擁有怪物般的驚人記憶力。慧眼識珠的江錫破格將他納入團隊，從此兩人成為法律界最強黃金拍檔。在法庭上縱橫捭闔、揭露真相與陰謀，他們並肩作戰，也建立深厚情誼，並在愛與抉擇間踏上命運的新篇章。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: Remember-兒子的戰爭(完)
programme.desc: 【俞承豪為父申冤，朴敏英成為他正義路上的唯一靠山！！】徐振宇擁有過目不忘的記憶力，為了替被誣陷為殺人犯的父親申冤成為了律師，與權勢貪腐正面對抗。與堅守正義的檢察官李仁雅，從質疑到並肩作戰，成為振宇最堅強的後盾。就在逐步逼近真相時，卻發現自己正逐漸失去記憶。他們攜手在權力夾縫中拚搏，在時間與遺忘賽跑，只為守護真相與心中那份信念與愛。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 我的魯蛇舅舅
programme.desc: 【翻拍BBC人氣英劇／魯蛇舅舅Ｘ強迫症外甥溫馨爆笑的家庭喜劇】由《雖然是精神病但沒關係》的自閉症哥哥吳正世，首次擔任男主角，在選秀節目中獲勝的他，本該朝歌手夢前進，不料積蓄突然遭朋友騙光，從此一蹶不振，成為無業遊名。某天因為姊姊與家暴丈夫離婚，而開始照顧起強迫症的外甥，過程中兩人總是不斷鬥嘴，關係相愛又相殺，而他也從中找回責任感，成為外甥的超人舅舅。

programme.title: 榴蓮小姐
programme.desc: 【古代仙女婆媳時空穿越竟重逢前世伴侶】韓國狗血教母林成漢2023年全新力作！朝鮮時代的杜榴蓮，雖嫁給丈夫朴一帥，但內心真正愛的是僕人石鐵，礙於身分地位的落差，榴蓮與石鐵始終只能維持主僕關係，石鐵更是遭婆婆痛下殺手。榴蓮和石鐵的兒子朴言，對金素貯一見鍾情，兩人馬上結為夫妻，然而朴言驟然離世，傷痛欲絕的婆媳倆人，竟在月蝕之夜穿越到了現代，並在丹家別墅中再次見到了曾經的愛人、丈夫，在這一世中他們會擦出什麼樣的火花呢？

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 陌生人(完)
programme.desc: 【怪力媽搭配毒舌女母女笑鬧同居火花不斷】一個是凡事衝動、毫無對策的媽媽，一個是灑脫率性、走自己路的女兒。原本就像陌生人一樣的母女，被迫住在同一屋簷下，雞飛狗跳成為日常。從降職的糗事、誤會的桃色風波，到接連不斷的麻煩事件，她們在鬥嘴中暗暗守護彼此。越是嫌棄對方，越是離不開對方——這場「陌生人同居記」，意外寫下母女間最爆笑、最暖心的篇章。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【王牌律師X怪物新人法律界最強拍檔真相一觸即發！】在韓國頂尖律師事務所KANG&HAM，崔江錫是無人能敵的王牌律師，精準果敢、戰無不勝。一次偶然，他遇見高延宇──沒有法學背景、未取得律師執照，卻擁有怪物般的驚人記憶力。慧眼識珠的江錫破格將他納入團隊，從此兩人成為法律界最強黃金拍檔。在法庭上縱橫捭闔、揭露真相與陰謀，他們並肩作戰，也建立深厚情誼，並在愛與抉擇間踏上命運的新篇章。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 玉面桃花總相逢
programme.desc: 本劇改編自藍艾草的同名小說，許清嘉自幼父母雙亡，寒門苦讀成榜眼，與世交胡家的小女胡嬌喜結連理。胡嬌雖然出身屠戶家，不通文墨，但性格開朗積極、不拘小節，將一切打理得井井有條。

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: Three Quarter Moon
programme.desc: Hartmut, a taxi-driver, is left in a bitter slump when his wife leaves him. That is, until he gets six-year-old Hayat and her mother in his taxi. In a serendipitous turn of events, Hayat is left under his care and she helps him learn to enjoy life again.

programme.title: Ghost Town Anthology
programme.desc: Set in a small town in Quebec, the film centres on the inhabitants of the town who are struggling to cope after teenager Simon Dubé is killed in a car accident. As the family and town grieve, the residents begin to report several ghost sightings.

programme.title: Run Up!
programme.desc: After a life-altering accident shatters her dreams, Elodie, a young hiker turned paraplegic, discovers the power of wheelchair sports. With the help of her trainer Isabelle, she is able to awaken from her lethargy and recognize true victories in life.

programme.title: The Golden Dream
programme.desc: Juan, Sara and Samuel, all 15 years old, flee from Guatemala towards the USA. On their journey through Mexico they meet Chauk, a Tzotzil indian who does not speak Spanish and has no official documents. They believe they will find a better world beyond the USA-Mexico border but they run into a harsh reality.

programme.title: Red, White And Brass
programme.desc: In a bid to sneak into the Tonga vs France rugby match, superfan Maka invents a fake band to perform for the pre-game show. With the match coming soon, Maka and his friends have four weeks to come up with a performance

programme.title: Murder Up North: Sievers And the Black Angel
programme.desc: An attendee of an angel seminar has been found beaten to death. The case becomes personal for Sievers when suspicions fall on fellow participant Hanne Wegener whom he knows from his past. Feldmann has no choice but to conduct the investigation undercover.

programme.title: Puan
programme.desc: When Professor Marcelo Pena finally is about to be appointed Head of the Philosophy Department, the famous and seductive Professor Sujarchuk returns from Europe to claim the kingdom for himself.

programme.title: Timeline
programme.desc: A romantic reunion turns into a life-or-death game of secrets and survival, where the past cannot stay hidden.

programme.title: Mr. K
programme.desc: Mr. K, a traveling magician, finds himself in a Kafkaesque nightmare when he can’t find the exit of the hotel, he has slept in. His attempts to get out only pull him deeper, entangling him further with the hotel and its curious inhabitants.

programme.title: The Traveller: At the End of the Night
programme.desc: Laurent, the brother of Captain Kandinsky, gets into an argument with a young woman who accuses him of harassment. All suspicion inevitably falls on Laurent when she is discovered dead the next day, and it is up to Kandinsky to clear his brother’s name.

programme.title: Pure White
programme.desc: Vural, a husband and a father who was raised in faith, leads a seemingly pious and conformist life. Yet, everything takes a sudden dark turn when he learns a truth that will force him to confront his views on religion and morality.

programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'skin', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S2) - Vote Okido
programme.desc: Mayor Oki and Geoffrey are making a lot of noise in the election for the next Mayor of OKIDO.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Omelette
programme.desc: Bingo is helping Mum make an omelette for Dad's birthday breakfast, but cracking eggs is harder than it looks, and Dad is getting hungrier by the minute.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, he explains that he was miming.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S5) - The Talent Badge
programme.desc: Out for a walk, the Squirrels spot an interesting poster - it's King Tiger advertising his Roar Talent Show. Naturally, the Squirrels are very keen to take part.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Ladybird's Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S1) - The Forbidden City, China
programme.desc: Some runaway Chinese drums roll towards The Forbidden City. Can the Go Jetters stop them?

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Bbq
programme.desc: It's lunchtime on Bluey's deck! But the BBQ needs a salad, so Bingo's relaxing sit-down will have to wait until she finds every colour of capsicum her cousins asked for!

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Bingo
programme.desc: When Bluey has a playdate at Chloe's, Bingo must learn how to play by herself. But all the games she knows need more than one person! Luckily Dad has a problem that needs solving.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Baby Humpback Whale
programme.desc: In this episode Andy, Jen and Scout head to the Pacific ocean, off the tropical islands of Hawaii, on a baby animal mission to see how a baby humpback whale prepares for its 5000 km migration North to the rich feeding grounds of Alaska.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S2) - Seacow Snow Trail

programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po receive a call on the Tubby Phone. It's the Tiddlytubbies who ring to say hello, just before the Tubby Phone Dance.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Pirate Chang Pao Chai discovers a leak in his ship after a successful raid on a foreign merchant ship. He goes ashore to get materials to patch up his ship, but encounters corrupt Qing officials oppressing the poor peasants. A good man at heart, he decides to help the peasants and gain a reputation of being a great pirate in the process.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: The Assassin
programme.desc: Notorious assassin Nieh Cheng has retired into hiding. However, when Premier Yen's family is massacred, he seeks out the reclusive swordsman and coaxes him into a final revenge mission in this epic story set in the Six Kingdom era.

programme.title: Three Sinners
programme.desc: Based on the classic Ming Dynasty novel The Water Margin, Three Sinners is a Huangmei Opera about love, betrayal, murder, and redemption. Starring Hong Kong's premiere movie couple, it is one of the grandest Eastmancolor-Shawscope costume musicals in the Shaw Brothers library.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huang's wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: Shaolin Temple
programme.desc: As more people are learning martial arts from Shaolin, the Qing court orders for it to be banned and plans to destroy the temple. The Shaolin disciples decide to take their protest to the streets, using Shaolin skills to curb their hatred, but when the Qing troops start attacking Shaolin Temple, the disciples vow to protect it at all costs.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy "House of 72 tenants", this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: Mercenaries From Hong Kong
programme.desc: Filmmaker Wong Jing produced Mercenaries From Hong Kong, his very first modern-day adventure drama. In the dramatic plot he wrote, he sends superstars Ti Lung, Chen Hui-min, Wang Lung-wei, Lo Lieh and Wang Yu on a deadly mission. The film's action sequences are all closely guided by three great kung fu choreographers, led by Tang Chia!

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: The Lizard
programme.desc: A seasoned burglar 'The Lizard' sets himself up against a corrupt police chief and announced that he will steal a diamond from a rich man's party. His real identity, which is discovered by the corrupt police chief's granddaughter, is actually a young policeman who is doing it all for justice.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chu's family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Mighty One
programme.desc: Lung seeks five volumes of a renowned Kung Fu manual to gain invincibility. When he believes a martial arts school master possesses the volumes, he kills him and his daughter but leaves behind a young brother and sister. Years later, Lung loses two volumes and starts another bloody hunt but each attempt is interrupted by two mysterious warriors...

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Wei Chun is a cocky young man sentenced to jail for killing a man in a fight. One day, Wei Chun picks a fight with a seemingly defenseless old man who completely thrashes him! The old man turns out to be the master of monkey style kung fu and as they become friends, he gives Wei Chun half of a medallion that would direct him to hidden secrets.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: The story is about the legendary Monkey King (Liu Chung-chun) teams up with Goddess of Mercy (Chao Li-chuan) and the Dragon Girl (Lung Nu) to battle the child god Hung Hai-erh (Ting Hua-chung),son of the Ox Demon (Hung Hai-erh) to rescue Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim (Teng Chio-jen).

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: My Young Auntie
programme.desc: An elderly landowner marries young Dai Nan to keep his inheritance away from his unscrupulous nephew before he dies. When Dai Nan brings along the deed to meet his other nephew, a series of amusing incidents happen with this "young" auntie, the nephew and his son. Kara Hui won Best Actress in the first Hong Kong Film Awards for her role as Dai Nan.

programme.title: Songfest
programme.desc: As its name implies, Songfest is an Eastmancolor-Shawscope costume musical, traditionally Chinese and timeless in content; yet revealing a spirited and modern technique. Shot on location at Taiwan's beautiful Sun-Moon Lake, it's a turbulent romance between a passionate tea picker Sung Yu Lan and a charming fisherman Li Chun Yang.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: Flying Guillotine 2
programme.desc: In a time of anti-Manchu sentiment, Emperor Yong Zheng employs his ruthless Blood Hound Corps to silence any dissenters. Only one man and his signature weapon, The Flying Guillotine, stand in their way.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Emperor Chien Lung and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung meets a famous courtesan in Suzhou and in order to spend as much time as possible with her, he builds a direct underground tunnel into the Forbidden City. The emperor's sudden appearances through this direct access shock his people but it is also at this time that he helps the needy and cracks the gambling business in Suzhou.

programme.title: The Golden Sword
programme.desc: Swordsman Long meets Feng while searching for his missing father and they soon fall in love and marry. When Long is kidnapped by 'Dragon Gate Palace' one day, Feng embarks on a rescue mission and reunites with Long, who manages to escape. Together, they confront the head of 'Dragon Gate Palace', and uncover a long-hidden secret.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, &amp; colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 3
programme.desc: Guo Jing and Huang Rong go to Iron Palm Peak to search for the Book of Wumu. The chief of Iron Palm discovers their visit, and seriously injures Huang. It seems only the Southern Emperor Duan can heal her, but will Huang be healed in time?

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai is perfect as Pak Su-cheng, the stunning snake goddess who assumes a womanly form so that she can taste the pleasures of a human life! Pak seduces young scholar, Hsu Hsien when she recognises him as her saviour in another life 1,000 years ago. But when Buddhist monk Fa Hai finds out about the union, the pair is forced to split...

programme.title: The Enchantress
programme.desc: Shot on the Shaws' lot in the final years of Hong Kong's greatest studio, The Enchantress tells the story of martial artists who disappear in the night! Intrigued, wanna-be detectiveswordsman Feng Chi-wu (Mok Siu-chung) is determined to find out what is happening. But when Feng finds out that an evil vampire spirit (Wei Chiu-hua) is killing swordsmen, he's in for more than he bargains for... It's an outlandish fairy-tale and martial arts fantasy, where your fists and sword aren't nearly enough!

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Wo Hu
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Police has placed more than a thousand undercover officers in various triad groups to bring down the largest criminal organization in Hong Kong. Betrayal, deceit and murder bring this group of "brothers" into a collision with the law and with each other!

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 97
programme.desc: Mr Lo has three sons, Leung, Fay and Kung; and a daughter-in-law, Eliza. While they seem like a normal family, their relationships need mending. Leung and Fay play a prank on their brother Kung on his birthday by falsely claiming that he has won the lottery. This sets off a chain reaction of funny mishaps that finally brings the family together.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Romantic Dream
programme.desc: Dino meets his dream girl Mandy and falls in love with her at first sight. However, she disappears suddenly and he only sees her again after nine years, when she is already married. To overcome the pain of losing his love, Dino finds a guru with supernatural power to make him meet Mandy in his dream.

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Andy is a mahjong master who is very popular in the neighbourhood. However, after being cursed by his ex-girlfriend, Andy always experiences bad luck when playing mahjong. Can he finally dodge this streak of bad luck?

programme.title: Kill Time
programme.desc: Mak stumbles upon an obscure website "Witch's Zone" when looking for a copy of her dead father's favorite song. The mysterious website only allows one purchase but Mak cannot resist buying one more purple scarf. Not only does the scarf triggers her memories of her father and her first love, it may also be a vital clue in a mysterious murder.

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Nine years ago, two legendary criminals, Bullet and Brain, vowed not to kill and lie before they disappeared. Both now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Bo Yi's husband is having an affair, so Bo Yi divorces him and joins the "Happy Spinsters Club" set up by her friends. However, she soon finds out that she does not enjoy being single and while sorting out her thoughts, her repentant husband begs her forgiveness. She must now decide on what she truly wants.

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Ka Shing meets Kitty one day and they fall quickly in love. However, Kitty disappears shortly and when they meet years later, she is already married. To comfort himself, Ka Shing asks a mystic master to let Kitty appear in his dreams so that he can be with her constantly, even though she can only be his dream lover...

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Ka Shing meets Kitty one day and they fall quickly in love. However, Kitty disappears shortly and when they meet years later, she is already married. To comfort himself, Ka Shing asks a mystic master to let Kitty appear in his dreams so that he can be with her constantly, even though she can only be his dream lover...

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father's underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau's economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: Ninth Happiness
programme.desc: A comedy starring many popular movie stars, this is a story about a magistrate and his brothers aiming to introduce sin and romance into the virtuous community of Rainbow Village. As they vie for the affections of a charming young village maiden, conflicts arise, adding a twist to their mischievous endeavours.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: The Eye 2
programme.desc: Joey looks to start a new life after a failed suicide attempt but finds herself pregnant and dare not tell her ex-boyfriend. At the same time, she realizes that a mysterious woman is stalking her and begins to hallucinate, leading to a nervous breakdown. Taking advice from an abbot, Joey decides to uncover the truth in order to protect her baby...

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Love and Let Love!
programme.desc: Cliff proposes to his girlfriend Terry but is killed in a car accident before she says "yes". Terry is devastated and inconsolable. When Cliff's ghost returns, they seem to go back to their good old days. However, Cliff is determined to help Terry get over his death and start anew.

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Eddie is hired by the Interpol to capture a human smuggling gang leader known as Snakehead. Eddie dies in an action to protect a sacred child from being kidnapped, but is brought back to life by the child's magical medallion, allowing him to finally kill Snakehead.

programme.title: The Medallion
programme.desc: Hong Kong cop Eddie is hired by the Interpol to capture a human smuggling gang leader known as Snakehead. Eddie dies in an action to protect a sacred child from being kidnapped, but is brought back to life by the child's magical medallion, allowing him to finally kill Snakehead.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 3
programme.desc: Gambling tycoon Man suddenly marries his new partner Sophie, which shocked his only son, Ken. In the wake of Man's heart attack, Ken must battle Sophie - who has persuaded Man to transfer his grand master title to her in the event of his death - for the rightful claim to the family's gambling business in a riveting game of mahjong.

programme.title: How to Choose a Royal Bride
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager has arranged for a Minister's daughter Qiong Yao, to become Emperor Kangxi's concubine. However, Qiong Yao escapes in pursuit of freedom in marriage and Kangxi is happy to not go through with the union. When Kangxi travels incognito to Jiangnan, he serendipitously encounters Qiong Yao, who disguises herself as a man...

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation...

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: As Wudang disciple Zhuo Yi Hang confronts the Demon Palace, he reunites with Lian Ni Shang, the woman who once saved him, and their love reignites. Lian, a disciple of the Demon Palace, endures torment to be with Zhuo but is shattered when he accidentally injures her. A fierce battle between good and evil unfolds!

programme.title: Protege
programme.desc: Undercover Police Nick has spent 8 years working for the drug baron Quin, so as to collect evidence of his drug trafficking activities. After gaining Quin's trust, Nick becomes his protege and succeeds him as the drug baron when Quin retires. However, Nick has lost himself in his split life between trading drugs and searching for criminal evidence.

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: It's a Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Golden Chicken 2
programme.desc: The sequel is set in 2046 when a 82-year-old Ah Kam stops a heartbroken young man from taking memory loss pills. To help ease his pain, Ah Kam shares her life stories from 2003, one of Hong Kong's toughest year with SARS, including the different people she comes across and the bittersweet romance between herself and her cousin.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Uniconned
programme.desc: Jun breaks the rules by sneaking a small, adorable dragon out of the Crystal Realm and bringing it home, but finds that her older brother, Eugene, has arrived and watches her every move.

programme.title: DRAGONS 9 REALMS S1 - Magma Breather
programme.desc: Tom has to keep his mom, Olivia, distracted while Jun, Alex, and D’Angelo use a new dragon to close off a cave leading to the Crystal Realm, and prevent her from discovering the dragons.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Bad Beat of the Blah Borelock
programme.desc: With fun in short supply, Harold and George persuade Krupp to dump the campers in the middle of the forest so they can learn to rough it.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Ghastly Danger of the Ghost Dentist
programme.desc: The pressure's on Harold and George to tell the scariest campfire story ever. Perhaps their tale of an ill-fated frontier dentist will do the trick.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Confounding Concoction of the Crooked Combotato
programme.desc: A fierce game of plot potato takes an unexpected twist when Melvin unleashes one of his most fiendish -- and carb-loaded -- creations yet.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Midnight Scrum
programme.desc: When Viggo puts a bounty on Hiccup's head, every Dragon Hunter in the world is after capturing Hiccup, so Toothless and the Riders must rescue him.

programme.title: Dragons: Race to the Edge S2 - Not Lout
programme.desc: When Snotlout screws up a mission, he must learn to be a leader and earn the trust of the other riders.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S2 - Red Paladin
programme.desc: A new leader of Voltron must be found before Lotor's forces attack.

programme.title: Dawn Of The Croods S2 - Deus Ex Monkhuaha Slak Attack
programme.desc: Sandy becomes jealous when the family gets an adorable monkhuahuaEep and Thunk act like lazy "slaks" instead of doing their schoolwork and chores

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S2 - Lucky and the No-Good Outlaw Butch Lepray
programme.desc: Lucky gets into trouble when the circus picks up a stranded woman who isn't what she seems

programme.title: Dinotrux S2 - Flynt
programme.desc: Ty gets jealous when a Hydrodon named Flynt becomes everyone's new hero, but when a blazing fire heads towards the ravine, Ty must ask Flynt for help

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Rumble In The Jungle
programme.desc: Zebby is upset when Raa Raa laughs at her rumbling tummy and runs off to hide. Raa Raa sets out to find his friend and apologise… he thinks it will be easy, he just has to listen out for the sound of her tummy, but who knew how many other rumbling noises there were?

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Favourite Noise
programme.desc: Raa Raa is inspired by his friends to search for his favourite noise in the jingly jangly jungle. The little lion cub and his friends set out to find out what Raa Raa's Favourite Noise could be…

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Ooo Ooo Slips Up
programme.desc: Raa Raa and the other animals keep slipping up on banana skins that are littering the jungle floor. Where could they have come from? Together the animals clear up the mess and discover who has been littering the jungle with banana skins.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - No Sleep Til Bedtime
programme.desc: It is nap time in the Jingly Jangly Jungle but Raa Raa is not tired and is determined to play hide and seek with his friends, whether they like it or not! But all this running about can be tiring work for a noisy little lion cub…

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Raa Raa's Rainy Day
programme.desc: It is raining in the Jingly Jangly Jungle. Raa Raa is annoyed as he doesn't think he'll be able to play with his friends… until they discover that the rain makes lots of exciting new noises.

programme.title: Raa Raa The Noisy Lion S1 - Two's Company
programme.desc: Raa Raa and Crocky inadvertently leave one of the others out of all their games. Will they realise that sometimes games can be more fun the more players you have?

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - A Knight's Tail
programme.desc: Huzzah! Gabby the Bold and Pandy the Purr-owd are Knights in Training, and they head into the dollhouse for the Royal Knighting Ceremony. But it turns out that someone's locked King Catnip in the tower and without him they'll have to cancel the Royal Knighting Ceremony! It's up to the Knights in Training to solve the mystery and save King Catnip by performing acts of knighthood. For our Cat of the Day, Pandy makes a shield craft!

programme.title: Gabby's Dollhouse S1 - DJ's Glow Ride
programme.desc: Gabby receives a special nighttime delivery, unboxing a glow-in-the-dark train engine. However, she realizes that she's missing the other three train cars to complete the whole train. The Gabby Cats help Gabby build the other three glow-in-the-dark train cars by creating shapes through interactivemusical games. In our Gabby Cat of the Day Segment, DJ Catnip sings a song.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Christmas Bonus - Boss Baby: Christmas Bonus
programme.desc: _x000D_ _x000D_When Boss Baby accidentally gets mistaken for an elf and sent to the North Pole on Christmas Eve, he mobilizes unpaid elf workers against an old nemesis: that charity-loving hippie people call Santa Claus. Meanwhile, Tim races to the North Pole to get his baby brother back home in time for Templeton Family Christmas traditions.

programme.title: Captain Underpants and the Xtreme Xploits of the Xplosive Xmas S2 - Captain Underpants and the Xtreme Xploits of the Xplosive Xmas Special
programme.desc: George and Harold love Christmas, but they feel like it could use some upgrades. So they make a comic about a new version of the holiday: BLISSMAS. Instead of red bows, laser shows! Instead of ugly sweaters, cool capes! Instead of decorating trees, creating tree-bots! The boys take Melvin’s time toad back to convince Santa to incorporate some of their ideas to his new holiday. But they come back to the present to find that their plan didn’t work quite how they’d hoped.

programme.title: Tip And Oh: Home For The Holidays S1 - Tip And Oh: Home For The Holidays
programme.desc: Oh takes it upon himself to introduce Christmas joy to his fellow Boovs. Unfortunately, his well-meaning mission nearly destroys the city.

programme.title: SPIRIT OF CHRISTMAS (RIDING FREE) S3 - Spirit Of Christmas
programme.desc: Lucky and friends must figure out how to get home in time for Christmas when a falling boulder -- and a serious snowstorm -- derail their travel plans.

programme.title: Puss in Boots: The Three Diablos S1 - Puss In Boots: The Three Diablos
programme.desc: After Puss in Boots is captured by soldiers he is enlisted to re-steal the priceless "Heart of Fire Ruby" a ruby stolen by the notorious, wicked and impossible-to-hear villain, known as The Whisperer. Puss must partner with the villain's henchmen, The Three Little Kittens, to seize the ruby. Babysitting has never been more dangerous. Will our hero Puss in Boots tame the Three Diablos in time to recover the ruby?

programme.title: Far Far Away Idol S1 - Far Far Away Idol

programme.desc: The Three Pigs live in a house together, but Heimlich gets scared when he sees Wolf move in next door and acting strange.

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP22
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: Madam Cutie On Duty - EP11
programme.desc: FA PING (Priscilla Wong), who was often made fun of by the others for being ugly during her childhood, underwent cosmetic surgery in the wake of an accident. Ever since then, she has been firmly convinced that an attractive appearance has a significant impact on one's life, and remains the same after joining the police.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP7
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: Battle Against Evil, The - EP8
programme.desc: General LI (TONG, MICHAEL) of the Chor Kingdom and wizard CHAI (CHAN HO, MOSES) were colleagues under the same mentor. LI killed CHAR when he found out that CHAR was having an affair with his wife SUKI (LEUNG TSAND, JADE). SUKI was ashamed of her affair, so she committed suicide. After she died, CHAI was furious and killed LI. He used bad magic to turn LI’s spirit into a cloud of hatred in order to prevent him from reincarnation.

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP22
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.

Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.
